## ABOUT US

Alhamd Corporation owns and operates a state-of-the-art textiles manufacturing facility in DG Khan,
Pakistan. Starting as small yarn spinning mill in 1987, Alhamd has grown to become one of the
largest textiles spinning units in the country. We have also integrated in-house cotton ginning and
low-cost power generation, to offer our customers and partners the highest quality products at the
most competitive prices.

[READ MORE][8]

### 1987

### 2500+

###### Happy Employees

### 170k

###### Yarn

###### Spindles

### 17MW

## PRODUCTS

Alhamd produces the highest quality textiles products at affordable rates. It all begins with the
right fibers, and we have built expertise in sourcing and producing the best cotton in Pakistan, as
well as working with established international cotton varieties, such as Pima cotton, Egyptian
cotton, and many more. We also work extensively with man-made fibers, such as Tencel, Viscose and
Polyester. Our focus is on our customers’ requirements, and we can produce specialized, custom
blends to cater to their quality parameters and price points.

[READ MORE][9]

## COMMITMENT TO QUALITY

Alhamd Corporation operates at the highest internationally-recognized standards to ensure the best
outcomes for its customers.

## Mil-Spec and PIA-Spec

Bally Ribbon Mills utilizes a wide array of fibers to manufacture woven narrow fabrics for critical
use applications. Nylon, Kevlar®, Nomex®, and Textured Nylon are a few of the many options BRM has
at its disposal to produce the highest quality end results. Learn more about the entire range here.

[View Mil-Spec and PIA-Spec][73]
[Mil-W-4088][74]

## Mil-W-4088

Mil-W-4088, or Mil-W-4088K, was cultivated for nylon webbing. Like all of Bally Ribbon’s Mil-Spec
products, this is Berry Amendment compliant and available in various widths, thicknesses, patterns,
and levels of tensile strength.

[View Mil-W-4088][75]
[Mil-DTL-5038K][76]

## Mil-DTL-5038K

Designed for lightweight nylon tapes used in binding and reinforcement applications, Mil-DTL-5038K
can replace Mil-T-5038H, is Berry Amendment compliant, and is available through Bally Ribbon Mills
in a range of dimensions.

[View Mil-DTL-5038K][77]
[Mil-W-5625K][78]

## Mil-W-5625K

This Mil-Spec product comprises woven nylon tubular webbing designed principally for parachute
applications. Bally Ribbon offers Mil-W-5625K in a scope of proportions.

[View Mil-W-5625K][79]
[Mil-T-87130][80]

## Mil-T-87130

Developed for Kevlar® tapes and webbing, Bally Ribbon Mills offers this Mil-Spec product, which is
Berry Amendment compliant, in a variety of sizes.

[View Mil-T-87130][81]

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

## Pvt Ltd vs LLP — Key Differences

Choosing the right business structure affects taxation, liability, compliance burden, and investor
readiness. Here's a quick comparison.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────
Factor           │Pvt Ltd                    │LLP                  
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Liability        │Limited                    │Limited              
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Min. Members     │2 directors, 2 shareholders│2 designated partners
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Tax Rate         │22% (base)                 │30% (flat)           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Annual Filings   │Higher — ROC + IT + audit  │Lower — MCA + IT     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Equity / VC      │✔ Allowed                  │✘ Not allowed        
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Foreign Ownership│✔ FDI allowed              │Limited routes       
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Startup India    │✔ Eligible                 │✔ Eligible           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Cost to Set Up   │₹6,000–₹15,000             │₹3,000–₹8,000        
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────
Choose **Pvt Ltd** if you plan to raise funding. Choose **LLP** for professional services firms with
lower compliance needs.

## How to Verify a GST Number

A valid GSTIN (Goods & Services Tax Identification Number) confirms a business is registered to
collect GST. Always verify before making B2B payments.
1. Go to **gst.gov.in** — no login required
2. Click *Search Taxpayer* → *Search by GSTIN / UIN*
3. Enter the **15-character GSTIN** and solve the CAPTCHA
4. Check the **Registration Status** — must show *Active*
5. Verify the **Legal Name** matches your vendor/supplier

How to read a GSTIN
27 AABCU9603R 1 Z 5
■ State code ■ PAN (10) ■ Entity ■ Z ■ Check
A **cancelled** or **suspended** GSTIN means the business cannot charge GST — input tax credit
claims will be disallowed.

## Pvt Ltd vs LLP — Key Differences

Choosing the right business structure affects taxation, liability, compliance burden, and investor
readiness. Here's a quick comparison.

─────────────────┬───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────
Factor           │Pvt Ltd                    │LLP                  
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Liability        │Limited                    │Limited              
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Min. Members     │2 directors, 2 shareholders│2 designated partners
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Tax Rate         │22% (base)                 │30% (flat)           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Annual Filings   │Higher — ROC + IT + audit  │Lower — MCA + IT     
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Equity / VC      │✔ Allowed                  │✘ Not allowed        
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Foreign Ownership│✔ FDI allowed              │Limited routes       
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Startup India    │✔ Eligible                 │✔ Eligible           
─────────────────┼───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
Cost to Set Up   │₹6,000–₹15,000             │₹3,000–₹8,000        
─────────────────┴───────────────────────────┴─────────────────────
Choose **Pvt Ltd** if you plan to raise funding. Choose **LLP** for professional services firms with
lower compliance needs.

# E-Textiles Network

## Welcome to E-Textiles Network

The E-Textiles Network brings together researchers and developers from academia and industry
interested in adding electronic functionality to textiles and their related products.

The E-Textiles Network is engaged in numerous activities to help promote the development of
E-Textiles, find out more below:

E-Textiles: International Conference on the Challenges, Opportunities, Innovations and Applications
in E-Textiles is an annual conference which gives people from academia and industry the opportunity
to discuss the exciting innovations and challenges in the rapidly emerging field of e-textiles.

### E Squared : A WORLD OF POSSIBILITIES

E Squared, a leader in the development and manufacturing of high-performance coated fabrics, film
sheeting and technical textiles is pleased to announce a major expansion of our production,
warehousing, and distribution capabilities.



### INNOVATION

Our cutting-edge blended fabric technology and global infrastructure are uniquely qualiﬁed to
position you as a leader in your industry. [E Squared][46] innovation will bring your company into
the future. Our equipment is built to be versatile, including product lines for a variety of
industries with strict specifications where products need to remain durable even under the harshest
conditions.

[Learn More][47]

### TRUSTED PERFORMANCE

You need a partner you can depend on – a partner who delivers and whom you can trust. At E Squared,
we are committed to our clients and we take responsibility for our fabrics. We will be with you each
step of the way to ensure your products perform at their highest potential.

### OUR CUSTOMERS

“One of the added benefits of the PRG geomembrane such as XTRM Ply® [EPSWrap] is that, due to its
inherent flexibility, it can be prefabricated into large panels by a qualified fabrication facility,
taking advantage of a climate-controlled environment.  This allows fabricators to seam, test the
seams, fold/package and ship to the jobsite in large panel sizes, minimizing or even eliminating
more problematic field seams, which would otherwise need to be done in the elements, and subject to
site conditions.”

Mark DeSandre
**Frank Roberts and Sons, Inc.**

We needed to provide temporary drinking water storage for the London Olympic Games. There was a
short timeline, and Wiefferink needed a quick solution…Erez understood the urgency of the matter and
made the production of the flexitank membranes their top priority. In order to meet the demands of
Wiefferink’s schedule, Erez ordered raw materials to be flown in by special air shipment.

The process for reusing flexible storage tanks is significant, and the capacity of the tanks has to
be stable during their lifespan. Erez’s foil was very much fit to perform this process, with the
best welding technique for the textile to retain as much storage capacity as possible.

Eelo
**Wiefferink**

# Embro – Ihr Hersteller für technische Textilien, Heizelemente & Sensoren. Made in Germany.

 

Als Hersteller technischer Textilien entwickeln und fertigen wir Halbzeuge – **in Kleinserien und
Großserien zwischen 500 und 100.000 Stück** – für Ihre industrielle Anwendung:

✓ Flexible **VDE-zertifizierte** elektrische Heizelemente und Heizmatten
✓ Textile Sensoren und Antennenstrukturen
✓ Sensormatten und smarte E-Textiles

Unsere technische Stickerei bringt leitfähige Fäden, Litzen, Drähte oder Heizleiter präzise auf
textile Trägermaterialien für maßgeschneiderte Funktionstextilien, direkt für die Weiterverarbeitung
in Ihrem Produkt.

**Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Herausforderung!**

## Technische Textilien: Entwickelt nach Ihren Anforderungen, gefertigt in Serie

[Embro GmbH - Kontakt - Hersteller Heizelemente, Heizmatten]

Als **Hersteller smarter, technischer Textilien** verbinden wir Entwicklungskompetenz mit moderner
Serienfertigung. Mit computergesteuerten [Stickmaschinen][81] bringen wir leitfähige Fäden, Litzen,
Drähte und Heizleiter präzise auf textile Trägermaterialien. Ob **industrielle Heizelemente und
Heizmatten, textile Sensoren oder Smart Textiles:** Gemeinsam mit Ihnen gestalten wir **Form,
Material, Layout und Funktion, exakt zugeschnitten auf Ihr Produkt** und Ihre industrielle
Anwendung. Dabei haben wir stets eines im Blick: **eine zuverlässige, flexible und kosteneffiziente
Fertigung in Serie.**

[Erfahren Sie mehr über unsere Produktion & Logistik][82]

## Was sind smarte, technische Textilien von Embro?

**Technische Textilien** haben viele Namen: [Smarte Textilien][83], [E-Textiles][84], intelligente
Textilien oder funktionelle Textilien. Sie **leiten, heizen, senden, empfangen, messen **und
**leuchten**, während ihre **textilen Eigenschaften **erhalten bleiben. Sie sind flexibel, robust,
knickbeständig, waschbeständig und leistungsfähig. Viele Branchen entdecken das große Potential
smarter Textilien als bessere Alternative zu herkömmlichen Technologien.

## Smart Textiles für Ihre industrielle Anwendung
## direkt vom Hersteller

Als Hersteller für technische Textilien entwickeln und produzieren wir flexible Funktionselemente
für OEMs und Industriepartner **maßgeschneidert für die Integration in Serienprodukte**. Ob
Heizmatte, Sensorik oder Smart Textiles: Entdecken Sie unsere Produkte für Ihre Anwendung – robust,
präzise und bereit für die Weiterverarbeitung.

# Engineering Tomorrow’s E-Textiles and Wearables

We design, prototype, test, and manufacture smart textiles for startups, brands, and industries.

[Get Started][15]

## Your One-Stop E-Textile Partner

We’re your one-stop partner for e-textile product development, from concept to manufacturing.
Trusted by brands and startups across global markets

### 25+

Trusted Globally

Clients

## Our Services

###### **Product Development**

Comprehensive expertise in e-textile and wearable technology product development

###### **Testing and Certification**

In-house testing facility for complete e-textile validation, including wash and dry durability

Proven experience in scalable manufacturing of e-textiles across all complexity levels

###### **Manufacturing**

## Our e-textile expertise spans multiple technologies and applications

### Conductive Structures & Interconnects
* **Conductive pathways** (knit, print, embroidery)
* **Interconnects & connectors**
* **Hard-to-soft transitions** (flex/rigid interfaces, strain relief)

##### Sensing & Biometrics
* **ECG** (electrocardiography)
* **EMG** (electromyography)
* **PPG** (photoplethysmography)
* **Skin temperature sensing**
* **IMU / motion tracking** (inertial measurement)
* **Sweat & biochemical sensors**

##### Active Wearable Functions
* **Haptics** (vibration/tactile feedback)
* **TENS** (electrical stimulation)
* **Heating**
* **Cooling**
* **Active compression**
* **Illumination** (LED/EL/LIGHT GUIDE)

## What is *FASHIONLACRUM?*

**FASHIONLACRUM** provides inspiration, demonstrations and valuable resources that explore the
intersection of fashion and technology.

The goal of **FASHIONLACRUM** is to empower designers, curators and creatives of varying backgrounds
to reimagine how we view, understand and experience fashion or other forms of dress with computer
technologies.

What **FASHIONLACRUM** Explores…
* ## Wearable Technology
  
  How can we use computer technologies to alter or elevate the experience of real clothing?
  
  [Learn More][32]
  [LED e-textiles jacket with circuit board design and matching mask. Made using LilyPad Arduino.
  Tutorial/Demonstration included.]
* ## Digital Fashion
  
  How can computer technologies create unique fashion experiences?
  
  [Learn More][33]
* ## Historic Costume Digitisation
  
  How can 3D reconstructions of historic costume aid conservation efforts and display?
  
  [Learn More][34]
  [Smartphone displaying of "Meiji Court Dress Virtual Experience" app interface, showcasing a
  virtual ceremonial court dress (taireifuku) with interactive features and information buttons.]

[Brittany Glassey, working on a furisode from the Matsukata House Museum collection, as part of her
research for Fashionlacrum.]

# About Brittany

#### ブリタニー グラッシー

My industry background is in fashion and product design, with a lifelong passion for combining
technology with wearables and the creative process. During my MA studies, I was introduced to how 3D
computer-aided-design could contribute to the conservation of historic costume. My present research
in costume digitisation focuses on recognising the materiality and historic context of the artefact
to help guide the digitisation process.

I am a New Zealander, having worked in commercial product design, bespoke bridal design, along with
hosting workshops and writing e-textiles resources for professional learning and development. In
Japan I worked as an archivist and completed digitisation projects for several museums. My
background and skills are varied, but all link back to my interests in technology, fashion and
mixing practical techniques with the digital space.

I am seeking new projects to further my research in how computer technologies can contribute to
historic dress and costume research. If you are interested, please make contact via
[**fashionlacrum@gmail.com**][35]

## What is *FASHIONLACRUM?*

**FASHIONLACRUM** provides inspiration, demonstrations and valuable resources that explore the
intersection of fashion and technology.

The goal of **FASHIONLACRUM** is to empower designers, curators and creatives of varying backgrounds
to reimagine how we view, understand and experience fashion or other forms of dress with computer
technologies.

What **FASHIONLACRUM** Explores…
* ## Wearable Technology
  
  How can we use computer technologies to alter or elevate the experience of real clothing?
  
  [Learn More][32]
  [LED e-textiles jacket with circuit board design and matching mask. Made using LilyPad Arduino.
  Tutorial/Demonstration included.]
* ## Digital Fashion
  
  How can computer technologies create unique fashion experiences?
  
  [Learn More][33]
* ## Historic Costume Digitisation
  
  How can 3D reconstructions of historic costume aid conservation efforts and display?
  
  [Learn More][34]
  [Smartphone displaying of "Meiji Court Dress Virtual Experience" app interface, showcasing a
  virtual ceremonial court dress (taireifuku) with interactive features and information buttons.]

[Brittany Glassey, working on a furisode from the Matsukata House Museum collection, as part of her
research for Fashionlacrum.]

# About Brittany

#### ブリタニー グラッシー

My industry background is in fashion and product design, with a lifelong passion for combining
technology with wearables and the creative process. During my MA studies, I was introduced to how 3D
computer-aided-design could contribute to the conservation of historic costume. My present research
in costume digitisation focuses on recognising the materiality and historic context of the artefact
to help guide the digitisation process.

I am a New Zealander, having worked in commercial product design, bespoke bridal design, along with
hosting workshops and writing e-textiles resources for professional learning and development. In
Japan I worked as an archivist and completed digitisation projects for several museums. My
background and skills are varied, but all link back to my interests in technology, fashion and
mixing practical techniques with the digital space.

I am seeking new projects to further my research in how computer technologies can contribute to
historic dress and costume research. If you are interested, please make contact via
[**fashionlacrum@gmail.com**][35]

[fashionlacrum@gmail.com][36]

[brittany.glassey.co.nz][37]

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

# Herculite® manufactures flexible PVC composite textiles for applications that demand exceptional
# aesthetics, durability, and return on investment.

[[About Herculite]][66]
[Our Products][67]
Powered by Innovation, Proven by Performance

Herculite is a pioneer in the flexible PVC composite textiles industry. We’ve been producing the
highest-quality fabrics, print media, and more for over 60 years. All of our products are developed,
produced, and checked for quality right here in the U.S.A.

Herculite products are made to last and create minimal environmental impact. From raw materials to
recycling, we believe that doing what’s right for our customers and what’s right for the planet are
one and the same.

[Our Story][68]
Our Products
Awning Fabrics
Architectural awnings designed with Herculite's® Awning Fabrics provide extra outdoor living and
extended seasonal space, protect interior furnishings from fading and ultra violet damage.
[Explore][69]
Performance Fabrics
Proven solutions for military, agriculture, and other demanding industries. Custom-engineered
fabrics available.
[Explore][70]
Healthcare Fabrics
Sure-Chek® brand medical fabrics are the original health care fabrics that were patented for use as
protective covering fabrics and today are the standard in the industry.
[Explore][71]
Marine Fabrics
For all pleasure craft, power or sail, the marine fabrics by Herculite® provide the best answer for
fabric accessories.
[Explore][72]
Tent & Structure
The Herculite family of Structure and Tent Fabric brands offers a complete selection of high
performance advanced technical textiles custom engineered specifically for the diverse needs of this
market from clear span structures to party tents and sidewall applications.

# Herculite® manufactures flexible PVC composite textiles for applications that demand exceptional
# aesthetics, durability, and return on investment.

[[About Herculite]][66]
[Our Products][67]
Powered by Innovation, Proven by Performance

Herculite is a pioneer in the flexible PVC composite textiles industry. We’ve been producing the
highest-quality fabrics, print media, and more for over 60 years. All of our products are developed,
produced, and checked for quality right here in the U.S.A.

Herculite products are made to last and create minimal environmental impact. From raw materials to
recycling, we believe that doing what’s right for our customers and what’s right for the planet are
one and the same.

[Our Story][68]
Our Products
Awning Fabrics
Architectural awnings designed with Herculite's® Awning Fabrics provide extra outdoor living and
extended seasonal space, protect interior furnishings from fading and ultra violet damage.
[Explore][69]
Performance Fabrics
Proven solutions for military, agriculture, and other demanding industries. Custom-engineered
fabrics available.
[Explore][70]
Healthcare Fabrics
Sure-Chek® brand medical fabrics are the original health care fabrics that were patented for use as
protective covering fabrics and today are the standard in the industry.
[Explore][71]
Marine Fabrics
For all pleasure craft, power or sail, the marine fabrics by Herculite® provide the best answer for
fabric accessories.
[Explore][72]
Tent & Structure
The Herculite family of Structure and Tent Fabric brands offers a complete selection of high
performance advanced technical textiles custom engineered specifically for the diverse needs of this
market from clear span structures to party tents and sidewall applications.
[Explore][73]

## Welcome to Intertextile Shanghai Home Textiles – Autumn Edition 

The gateway to Asia's home living

Intertextile Shanghai Home Textiles is Asia's leading home textile event which will be held on** 18
– 20 August 2026** at the **National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), China**. It is a
dynamic platform for industry professionals to source and to gain design inspirations through the
conveniently structured product displays and the fringe programme. In 2025, Nearly 900 exhibitors
and more than 35,000 visitors joined the event.

## Participants' comments

Previous Next

> Having exhibited at Intertextile Shanghai Home Textiles since 2016, we are proud to present our
> self-repairing voiles this year. We emphasise our commitment to natural and sustainable qualities,
> using materials like recycled yarn in our curtains. We continue to return to this fair because the
> organisers are highly professional and the brand awareness is effective – bringing us genuine
> clients. This year, approximately 60% of the buyers we met were from Mainland China, while 40%
> hailed from various countries and regions, including Taiwan, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam,
> Argentina, Ecuador, Mexico, and Brazil.
> 
> Bona Home, Türkiye,
> Exhibitor, Mr Suleyman Altiok, Sales Manager

> This is our first time at the fair, and it has exceeded my expectations. We see potential for
> opening new business opportunities. We've connected with interested visitors from the Middle East,
> China, and beyond, engaging in meaningful discussions about our Persian carpets, which are
> renowned for quality, variety, pattern, design and use of natural raw materials. The fair provides
> a vital platform for us to showcase the differences between handmade and machine-made carpets,
> allowing customers to experience our quality handmade products firsthand. Besides, the fringe
> events are important for us to stay informed about industry trends.
> 
> Tavana Carpet, Iran,
> Exhibitor, Mr Abed Hashemi, Marketing Manager

> I’m representing the biggest pattern design service provider in Scandinavia, displaying our
> designs by ten Finland-based designers. So far, it's been very busy for us – many of our target
> buyers are stopping at our booth. This fair is a great platform for us as it allows us to connect
> closely with customers, gather feedback on our services, and assess the market’s pricing levels.
> Our designs focus on three concepts: classic, lovely, and whimsical. They differ dramatically, as
> we aim to follow global home textile trends while also creating timeless patterns.
> 
> Patternsfrom Agency, Finland,
> Exhibitor, Ms Kristina Tergujeff, Creative Director

> We are exploring a wide variety of textiles, ready-made curtains, and soft furnishings, while also
> keeping an eye on fresh designs and innovations. We came across several impressive fabrics we
> hadn’t seen before, many presented by Chinese manufacturers offering diverse prints, patterns, and
> rolled stock ideal for quick orders. The fair provides a great opportunity to discover suppliers,
> and we’ve already identified promising ones for future collaboration. There’s a lot to cover
> within three days, but the event is both comprehensive and high quality. The fringe programme adds
> further value, and overall, we’re pleased with the experience and look forward to returning.
> 
> Harvey Furnishings, New Zealand,
> Visitor, Ms Margot Johnson, Head of Product, Buying & Marketing

> This fair is a fantastic chance to discover new collections that can enhance our production of
> home textiles, including cushions, bed covers, and curtains for large customers in Italy and
> Europe. We are actively seeking suppliers from around the world, particularly from China, India,
> Pakistan, and Türkiye, due to their high-quality production. We've already made a promising
> contract with a new supplier. Eco-friendly materials are a crucial focus for us, as customer
> demand for sustainable textiles continues to rise. It's essential that our materials are sourced
> responsibly and meet eco-certification standards.
> 
> F.lli Carillo Tarde srl, Italy,
> Visitor, Mr Pasquale Carillo, Member of the Board of Directors at CIS SpA,

> The forum unites textile experts to enhance consumer awarenes

# Kylie Peppler


#### **Professor of Informatics & Education
#### Director of [The Creativity Labs][26]
#### Co-Director of [The Connected Learning Lab][27]
#### University of California, Irvine
#### **

An artist by training, Dr. Peppler is a Professor of Informatics and Professor of Education at
University of California, Irvine, where she engages in research that focuses on the design of new
technologies to support learning and participation within traditionally minoritized populations,
particularly at the intersection of the arts and STEM learning ecosystems.

Dr. Peppler earned an NSF early CAREER award for her work on how e-textiles and other computational
construction kits popularized through the Maker movement can deepen learning and broaden
participation across a range of STEM fields. Dr. Peppler's studies have been published in leading
journals in the fields of education, technology and the arts, including *Science Education;
Computers & Human Behavior; Mind, Culture & Activity; British Journal of Educational Technology;
Journal of Science and Educational Technology; Studies in Arts Education; Review of Research in
Education; Teachers College Record; and Learning, Media & Technology*, among many others.
Additionally, Dr. Peppler is the author or editor of over 10 books published by a range of outlets,
including MIT Press, Peter Lang, Routledge, SAGE Publications, and Teachers College Press.

Through this work, Dr. Peppler has received several awards, including the Mira Tech Educator of the
Year, Indiana Governor's Award for Tomorrow's Leaders, American Society for Engineering Education
(ASEE) Pre-College Engineering Education Division Best Paper Award, One of 20 nominated for SIGCSE
Top Ten Papers of All Time Award, Outstanding Junior Faculty Award from Indiana University, and
Outstanding Alumni Early Career Award from Psychological and Brain Studies at Indiana University.
Her work has been consistently supported by the National Science Foundation as well as a range of
foundations, federal and industry partners, including the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation, the
Spencer Foundation, the Wallace Foundation, Google.org, Wellcome Trust, US Department of Education,
Boeing, Indiana Department of Education, New York Community Trust, Chicago Community Trust, Best
Buy, Fossil Foundation, GAP Inc., National Geographic, as well as the Center for Craft, Creativity,
and Design.

Dr. Peppler sits on the Editorial Boards for the *International Journal for Computer Supported
Collaborative Learning and Computer Science Education* and has recently served as Guest Editor for
the *British Journal of Educational Technology and Sustainability*. Dr. Peppler was also the lead
editor of the two-volume *SAGE Encyclopedia of Out-of-School Learning*.

Collaborative Learning and Computer Science Education* and has recently served as Guest Editor for
the *British Journal of Educational Technology and Sustainability*. Dr. Peppler was also the lead
editor of the two-volume *SAGE Encyclopedia of Out-of-School Learning*.

## Talks[][31]

Dr. Peppler shares the latest research findings regularly, with over 100 refereed talks at
conferences, such as the American Educational Research Association (AERA), Computer Supported
Collaborative Learning (CSCL), International Conference of the Learning Sciences (ICLS), Connected
Learning Summit (CLS), and others, in addition to over 130 invited talks around the world. Dr.
Peppler has given over 15 keynote presentations--including those at the NSF CyberLearning Synthesis
and Envisioning Meeting, American Library Association, FabLearn Conference, Make:Education Forum,
Harvard/MIT Learning and the Brain Conference, among others--and has been invited to give
presentations at several distinguished national meetings, such as speaking at the Consortium for
Schools Networking (CoSN), Smithsonian, White House Champions for Computer Science, Carnegie

the National Science Foundation on her work on new collaborative design technologies.

### Frequently Asked Questions
* How does the LEL compare to traditional flex PCBs and printed inks on TPU?
  
  The LEL offers several advantages over traditional flexible printed circuit boards (PCBs) and
  printed inks on thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU):
  * **Flexibility and Stretchability**: More flexible than flex PCBs, with up to 50% stretch in
    serpentine designs.
  * **Conductivity**: Provides a 40% improvement in conductivity over printed inks on TPU, with
    consistent resistance even when stretched.
  * **Environmental Considerations**: Available in silver-free conductors for improved
    sustainability, and production avoids heavy chemicals.
* What is the production capacity for the LEL?
  
  The LEL is produced in an ISO 13485- and ISO 9001-certified facility, with a capacity of up to
  20,000 units per week. The cost can be as low as $0.05 per square inch, making it scalable and
  cost-effective for various industries.
* How can I request a sample of the LEL?
  
  You can request a free sample of the LEL by going to our sample request form here. Provide your
  name, email, and how you heard about Loomia, and the team will get back to you.
* Where is Loomia located?
  
  Loomia is based in Brooklyn, New York. For more information or to get in touch, you can visit
  their website's
  
  These FAQs provide an overview of Loomia's offerings and capabilities. For more detailed
  information, please visit their official website.
* In which industries can the LEL be applied?
  
  The LEL is versatile and can be applied across multiple industries, including:
  * **Automotive**: Enhancing interior features with integrated electronics.
  * **Robotics and AR/VR**: Providing responsive interfaces and feedback mechanisms.
  * **Medical and Wellness**: Integrating sensors and heating elements into wearable devices.
* What functionalities does the LEL provide?
  
  The LEL offers a range of functionalities, including:
  * **HMI / Switches**: Enabling touch-sensitive controls integrated into soft surfaces.
  * **Flexible Heaters**: Providing uniform heating across various applications.
  * **Antenna and Cabling**: Facilitating data transmission and connectivity.
  * **Pressure Sensors/FSRs**: Detecting and measuring pressure or tactile forces.
* What is the Loomia Electronic Layer (LEL)?
  
  The Loomia Electronic Layer (LEL) is a flexible, thin, and drapable circuit system designed to
  integrate seamlessly into textiles and other soft materials. It offers functionalities such as
  heating, sensing, and data transmission, making it suitable for applications in automotive
  interiors, medical devices, and wearables.

  * **Flexibility and Stretchability**: More flexible than flex PCBs, with up to 50% stretch in
    serpentine designs.
  * **Conductivity**: Provides a 40% improvement in conductivity over printed inks on TPU, with
    consistent resistance even when stretched.
  * **Environmental Considerations**: Available in silver-free conductors for improved
    sustainability, and production avoids heavy chemicals.
* What is the production capacity for the LEL?
  
  The LEL is produced in an ISO 13485- and ISO 9001-certified facility, with a capacity of up to
  20,000 units per week. The cost can be as low as $0.05 per square inch, making it scalable and
  cost-effective for various industries.
* How can I request a sample of the LEL?
  
  You can request a free sample of the LEL by going to our sample request form here. Provide your
  name, email, and how you heard about Loomia, and the team will get back to you.
* Where is Loomia located?
  
  Loomia is based in Brooklyn, New York. For more information or to get in touch, you can visit
  their website's
  
  These FAQs provide an overview of Loomia's offerings and capabilities. For more detailed
  information, please visit their official website.
* In which industries can the LEL be applied?
  
  The LEL is versatile and can be applied across multiple industries, including:
  * **Automotive**: Enhancing interior features with integrated electronics.
  * **Robotics and AR/VR**: Providing responsive interfaces and feedback mechanisms.
  * **Medical and Wellness**: Integrating sensors and heating elements into wearable devices.
* What functionalities does the LEL provide?
  
  The LEL offers a range of functionalities, including:
  * **HMI / Switches**: Enabling touch-sensitive controls integrated into soft surfaces.
  * **Flexible Heaters**: Providing uniform heating across various applications.
  * **Antenna and Cabling**: Facilitating data transmission and connectivity.
  * **Pressure Sensors/FSRs**: Detecting and measuring pressure or tactile forces.
* What is the Loomia Electronic Layer (LEL)?
  
  The Loomia Electronic Layer (LEL) is a flexible, thin, and drapable circuit system designed to
  integrate seamlessly into textiles and other soft materials. It offers functionalities such as
  heating, sensing, and data transmission, making it suitable for applications in automotive
  interiors, medical devices, and wearables.

Text to speech, explained

## Turn any text into natural speech

Text to speech turns written words into spoken audio. The best voices don't read one word at a time
— they sound like a person reading to you, with natural pauses, rhythm, and emphasis. That's why a
paragraph you type into the converter above comes back sounding like someone speaking, not a machine
spelling words out.

## How to convert text to speech online

Three steps, all on this page. Type or paste your text into the box, pick a voice — choose your
language first if you don't need English — and press Generate. The audio plays right away, and the
MP3 download is free. No account, no watermark, no trial clock.

## 93 free text to speech voices in 19 languages

The free converter comes with 93 voices — male and female — across English, Spanish, French, German,
Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and
Arabic, among others. That's enough range to narrate a video in one language and welcome your
customers in another. You can convert up to 1,000 characters at a time and 5,000 characters a day,
and the allowance resets every day — come back tomorrow and keep converting for free.

## When you need more than a good reading voice

Some projects need a voice with a personality — warm for a bedtime story, confident for a product
video, calm for a meditation track. That is what the expressive voices in the locked row are for.
They take direction the way a voice actor would, keep their character across a whole book or
podcast, and make listeners forget they're hearing a recording made from text. Press play on any of
them to hear the difference; creating with them takes a free account.

## What people make with it

The most common things we see: video and course narration finished in minutes instead of takes,
audiobooks produced chapter by chapter, articles turned into something you can listen to on a
commute, an easier way to read for anyone who prefers listening, and quick voiceover drafts that let
a team approve a script before booking studio time. If your text can be read, it can be spoken.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is this text to speech tool free?

Yes. You can convert up to 5,000 characters every day without creating an account, and the MP3
download is included. The allowance resets daily, so you can come back tomorrow and keep going free.

### How do I convert text to speech online?

Type or paste your text into the box at the top of this page, pick a language and a voice, and press
Generate. The audio plays right away and you can download it as an MP3.

### Can I download the audio?

Yes — every conversion comes with a free MP3 download. There is no watermark and no trial clock.

### How much text can I convert at once?

Up to 1,000 characters per conversion and 5,000 characters per day for free. If you work with longer
texts — articles, chapters, whole books — a free account raises the limits and opens the full
studio.

### What languages does it support?

The free converter speaks 19 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian,
Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and Arabic —
93 voices in total, male and female.

### Can I use the audio commercially?

Audio from the free converter is for personal projects. Commercial use — monetized videos, client
work, ads, anything that makes money — requires a commercial plan, which includes full commercial
rights.

### Do the voices sound natural or robotic?

Natural. The voices read with real pauses, rhythm, and emphasis rather than word-by-word. The
expressive voices go further still — press play on any of them above and judge with your own ears.

# Our certifications

OEKO-TEX® standards enable everyone to make responsible decisions and protect natural resources.
Driven by sustainability and a dedication to transparency, our work is grounded in proven science.
Explore our portfolio [here][69] or apply for your chosen certification or service. 

[
[OEKO-TEX® MADE IN GREEN certification]

The MADE IN GREEN label identifies textiles and leather goods tested for harmful substances and
which have been manufactured under sustainable and socially responsible conditions.

][70]
[
[OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certification]

All types of textiles that have been tested for harmful substances, from yarns to the finished
product, may bear the STANDARD 100 product label.

][71]
[
[OEKO-TEX® ORGANIC COTTON certification]

The ORGANIC COTTON certification offers verification from farm to product. Products bearing this
label have been tested for the use of genetically modified organisms (GMOs) and harmful substances.
 

][72]
[
[OEKO-TEX® LEATHER STANDARD certification]

The LEATHER STANDARD label is tailored to leather articles which have been tested for harmful
substances. Certification can be awarded for leather semi-finished products, finished leather,
leather fibre materials up to finished articles and accessories.

][73]
[
[OEKO-TEX® STeP certification]

STeP certifies production facilities which manufacture textile and leather articles under
sustainable production conditions.

][74]
[
[OEKO-TEX® ECO PASSPORT certification]

The ECO PASSPORT identifies chemicals, colourants and auxiliaries used in the textile and leather
industry which are not harmful to health and which are environmentally friendly.

][75]
[
[OEKO-TEX® RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS certification]

RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS supports you on preventing or mitigating existing and potential negative
impacts of business operations within your own activities, your supply chains and your wider
business relationships. 

][76]

# OTEX Custom Webbing Manufacturer

## ANTICIPATING THE FUTURE WITH YOU

OTEX Specialty Narrow Fabrics® is an advanced manufacturer of high-performance narrow fabrics. We
offer a large and diverse catalogue of product solutions, as well as comprehensive custom product
development services.  This, to ensure we can provide you with textile components that meet your
company’s unique needs and challenges.  

The OTEX Research & Development team works closely with our clients to improve and differentiate
their products from commodity solutions. We share your commitment to performance excellence.  

Our Quality Control Test Lab ensures the sourcing, strength, and safety of all our products and our
best-in-class production work-flows deliver advanced innovations – on-time and at optimal costs. 

 Customer engagement is paramount here at OTEX; our team members provide a wide range of knowledge,
experience, and expertise. You can rely on them to be proactive, perceptive, and responsive to your
needs.

### Traceability

Bringing the future into a much-revered dwindling craft by merging revolutionary technology with an
ancient Lankan heritage, we seek to turn the ripples of socio-economic change into waves by
integrating blockchain technology into our digital fabric making each step of the process as
transparent as possible.

## [Smart Textile Alliance][6]

Smart Textile Alliance (STA) is a private not-for-profit organization promoting industry standards,
collaboration, and use of e-textile technologies. We support development of innovative e-textile
products through access to trusted suppliers, contemporary knowledge, activities and events.

[Find Development Partners][7]    [Discover Leading Research][8]

## [A diverse Community of Specialists][9]

STA supports collaboration with researchers and companies across the entire e-textiles supply chain,
creating a community where SMEs, large enterprises and R&D organisations contribute diverse
professional expertise in innovative products and services.

[Visit our Blog][10]    [Join our Community][11]

## [Setting Standards for Sustainable e-textiles][12]

Smart textiles are a disruptive technology combining microelectronics and textiles, increasing value
for end-users and extending product lifetimes. STA promotes standardization of components and
modular system architectures that facilitate replacement and recycling for sustainable products.

[Standardization][13]    [Sustainability][14]

to scale up your business.

# Your belting solution provider

Since its establishment in 1989, the YONGLI Belting Group is a specialized manufacturer of light
duty conveyor belts. YONGLI boasts a complete product range of conveyor belts coated with PVC, TPU,
TPO, TPEE and Silicon applicable in various kinds of industries.

YONGLI has built a solid reputation by designing, manufacturing and fabricating high quality
